source: Manually prepared network reliability correction after the first formal server E12 B1 attempt timed out downloading from official Debian sources. Replace Debian DEB822 URLs with the Tsinghua TUNA HTTPS Debian/Debian Security mirrors, force IPv4 and retry three times for update and install. Keep only gcc/make/libc6-dev, unchanged project/build/runtime instructions and apt list cleanup. This revised candidate has not been run on the server.
allowed_addition: RUN sed -i -e 's|https\{0,1\}://deb\.debian\.org/debian-security|https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian-security|g' -e 's|https\{0,1\}://security\.debian\.org/debian-security|https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian-security|g' -e 's|https\{0,1\}://deb\.debian\.org/debian|https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian|g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && apt-get -o Acquire::ForceIPv4=true -o Acquire::Retries=3 update && apt-get -o Acquire::ForceIPv4=true -o Acquire::Retries=3 install -y --no-install-recommends gcc make libc6-dev && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
